The algebra works correctly:
- `type:office` — entity has it (T), message asserts it (T) → composed: T⊙T = T → restricted: T⇒T = t. **Agreement.**
- `status:draft` — entity has it (T), message doesn't (⊥) → composed: T⊙⊥ = ⊥ → restricted: ⊥⇒T = t. **Entity retains its own assertion.**
- `status:active` — entity doesn't have it (⊥), message asserts it (T) → composed: ⊥⊙T = ⊥ → restricted: ⊥⇒⊥ = t. **Vacuous truth — the entity has nothing to say against it.**
